title: "pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells"
output: html_document
date: "2026-02-27"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells <- read_csv("../Data/pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells.csv")
```
```{r}
show_col_types = FALSE
```

```{r}
pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells <- pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells %>%
  mutate(ratio = (VsgRings / TotalCells))
```

```{r}
pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary <- pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Group, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), TotalCell_mean = mean(TotalCells), TotalCell_sd = sd(TotalCells))
```

```{r}
stat_results <- pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  rstatix::t_test(ratio ~ Group) %>% 
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 0.5, dodge = 0.8)
print(stat_results)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary,
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio), 
    fill = "grey85",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells,
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio, colour = as.factor(Replicate)),
    width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 3, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_results,
    label = "p.signif",
    tip.length = 0.05,
    bracket.size = 0.7,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_prism() +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("Vsg RC to Total Follicle Cell Ratio") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{r}
ggsave("../Results/pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells.pdf", width= 5, height= 7)
```

```{r}
pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary %>% 
  group_by(Group) %>% 
  summarise(Mean = mean(ratio))
```
